$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/collab.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Office only: apps/factory-api's notifications, followers, mentions and tasks (B-W2a-20) write them through command(), the fan-out in the worker in the tenant's system context; the API keeps each person to their own notifications and checks the record's view permission on every task and follow. The floor and link sessions read and write nothing here (no floor inbox). W2b (B-W2b-156): a portal session reads its own party's notifications (Notification.partyId is set exactly when the person is a partner user; the API keeps each person to their own and marks them read, done or snoozed in the tenant's system scope), never who in the office caused one (actorId hidden); deliveries, followers, mentions and tasks stay the office's. TH-5 (threads plan, schema wave 8/9, B-TH-065): but a portal session reads the follower rows of its own party, its people who are members of its own projects (RecordFollower.partyId). TH-9 (threads plan, schema wave 9/9, B-TH-090): ComposerDraft keeps each person's unsent text per record: the office writes an office person's, a portal session its own party's people's (the API keeps each person to their own); the floor none; removed when sent or discarded and with the person's erasure. NotificationDelivery and MessageMention are append-only (`@append-only`; the …_platform_w2a_guards triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login). A notification is kept (its deliveries name it), a task is cancelled, never deleted; a follower row is removed when its person unfollows. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Notification.about: The fan-out writes one row per person per event; the office reads a person's own and marks them read, done or snoozed. W2b: a partner user's rows carry the person's party, and a portal session reads its party's (the API, its person's own), never the office person who caused one.

NotificationDelivery.about: The worker logs each attempt to bring a notification outside the app (e-mail now, push in W2b) and reads the log; nobody changes or removes an entry.

RecordFollower.about: The office adds followers (the creator, an assignee, a person mentioned, or by choice), mutes and removes them (unfollow), and the fan-out reads them. TH-5 (B-TH-065, PROJ-G04, PROJ-G06; PR-03): a colleague added by hand follows with reason ADDED (the adder in createdById); a project's members of its outside company are that company's portal people, added one by one by the office (reason ADDED), whose rows name their party (partyId, set exactly for a portal person: the …_projects_th_guards trigger). A portal session reads its own party's member rows (the API: the projects its person may open, and who of its own company is in them), never the office's followers (no party) nor who in the office added someone; it writes none (only the office adds and removes people).

MessageMention.about: The office writes one row per person an internal note mentions, with the note, and reads a person's mentions; nobody changes or removes one.

ComposerDraft.about: TH-9 (B-TH-090): what one person typed and has not sent, one draft per person and record (or the portal's New order). The office writes, saves again and removes (sent or discarded) an office person's own drafts (the API: never another person's); a portal session reads, writes, saves again and removes the drafts of its own party's people (partyId, the writer's party; the API keeps each person to their own: nobody reads another person's draft), on records of its own party only. A person's erasure removes their drafts (the …_threads_later_th_guards trigger on ErasureRecord). The floor reads none. A draft is the person's own data (purpose: their account; no `personal` entry: the purposes of src/ownership.ts are the workers', and the person reads their own draft), named in the privacy notice.

Task.about: The office makes, assigns, completes, reopens, snoozes and cancels tasks on records or of their own, and reads them (My tasks, a record's side panel, Today). TH-3 (B-TH-038, PR-03): a task made from a message names it (messageId: a message of the thread of the task's own record, set when the task is made, never changed; the …_threads_composer_th_guards trigger); office only, like the rest of the task.
